## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      10 avis récents mentionnent prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 17 sept. 2026 - 27 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Gayle Warren_, 27 sept. 2026, 1/5: "I thought I had cancelled this correctly via email. But I see you took a payment from my Visa without consent. $89.99 please ensure my account/subscription is CANCELLED I don't require it!"
            2. _Riina_, 27 sept. 2026, 1/5: "SCAM! FORCED SUBSCRIPTION IMPOSSIBLE TO CANCEL!"
            3. _Uyen Vo_, 25 sept. 2026, 1/5: "The app automatically charge my credit card eventhough I cancelled subscription already."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      6 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 23 mai 2026 - 23 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Engin Volkan_, 23 sept. 2026, 1/5: "30 day money back guarantee has conditions which is only visible in the details of their policy. Do not assume that you can easily change your mind in 30 days. Once they have your money, they'll hold on to that as much as possible like they'll ask for screenshots and proof of usage for 7 days. How exactly is this a guarantee? Check their policy and don't be fooled with their ads. Buggy onboarding, survey keeps crashing, support manually changed it two times, but I still need proof, right..."
            2. _Sabina Kotiranta_, 23 mai 2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
            3. _Bartholomew Lunt_, 23 juil. 2026, 2/5: "daily work out is good but it keeps crashing and I can't track anything except the daily workout once it actually loads."
<!--/ir-theme-->
